panels.title: Traffic by destination country

targets.rawSql: SELECT DstCountry AS lookup, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime GROUP BY DstCountry ORDER BY bytes DESC

panels.description: Where your internet traffic goes, by destination country, from NetFlow.

panels.title: Traffic by protocol

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS time, dictGetOrDefault('default.protocols', 'name', toUInt8(Proto), toString(Proto)) AS metric, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) / 60 AS bytes_per_sec FROM flows WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

panels.description: Internet traffic by protocol over the selected time range, from NetFlow.

panels.title: Top hosts (source IP)

targets.rawSql: SELECT replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '') AS source_ip, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime GROUP BY SrcAddr ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Hosts, local or remote, that sent the most data in the selected time range. Downloads show up under the remote servers (CDNs and so on) that sent them.

panels.title: Top destination ASNs

targets.rawSql: SELECT DstAS AS asn, if(DstAS = 0, 'Private or unknown (local traffic)', dictGetOrDefault('default.asns', 'name', DstAS, '')) AS name, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime GROUP BY DstAS ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Networks (autonomous systems) that received the most data in the selected time range. ASN 0 is traffic with no known network: mostly local and Tailscale addresses.
